mainEntity.name: How do you learn to play Sudoku?

acceptedAnswer.text: To play Sudoku, fill the 9x9 grid so that each row, column, and 3x3 subgrid contains all numbers from 1 to 9 without any duplicates. Start with grids that have more pre-filled numbers to practice.

mainEntity.name: Can I play Sudoku online for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can play Sudoku on Mindhack.in completely free in your web browser. No registration, download, or installation is required.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to solve a Sudoku puzzle?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time to solve a Sudoku puzzle depends on the difficulty level. An easy puzzle can take 5 to 10 minutes, while extreme levels might take 30 minutes or more.

mainEntity.name: Does playing Sudoku improve your brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, playing Sudoku regularly helps enhance memory, focus, logical thinking, and cognitive speed by keeping your brain active and challenged.
